title.zh: 将巴塔内斯省巴斯科市镇的迪普坦小村改设为该市镇名为San Antonio De Padua村的法案
title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Diptan in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Antonio De Padua of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act to Convert the Sitio of Diptan in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Antonio De Padua of Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Sitio Diptan tại Thị trấn Basco, Tỉnh Batanes thành Barrio với tên gọi Barrio San Antonio De Padua của thị trấn nói trên
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะซิติโอ Diptan ในเทศบาล Basco จังหวัด Batanes เป็น บาริโอในชื่อบาริโอ San Antonio De Padua ของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Diptan di Kotamadya Basco, Provinsi Batanes menjadi Barrio dengan nama Barrio San Antonio De Padua dari kotamadya tersebut
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sitio Diptan di Perbandaran Basco, Wilayah Batanes kepada Barrio dengan nama Barrio San Antonio De Padua daripada perbandaran tersebut

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1332_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Diptan, in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of San Antonio de Padua of said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
